items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. Oh, she had a wonderful voice. A terrific voice.

ctx.x: No. It's very remarkable. Well, Cootie, then 1968 was that second Sacred Concert at the Cathedral of St. John the Divine. I just wanted to talk to you about that beautiful voice, Alice Babbs. Surely you love that voice, don't you?
